violations.type: Incorrect semantic property (value instead of label)
violations.explanation: The text content is exposed via the 'value' property rather than 'label'. Value is intended for the current value of controls (e.g., sliders, text fields); static text should be exposed via 'label'. Some screen readers may announce it oddly or not as plain text.

violations.type: Misleading semantics label on text spans
violations.explanation: Each TextSpan has its semanticsLabel set to '-', which would cause screen readers to announce dashes instead of the actual text if the parent's excludeSemantics were removed or changed. This is a fragile workaround that replaces meaningful content with a meaningless label.

violations.type: Loss of emphasis information for assistive technologies
violations.explanation: Bold (emphasized) parts are conveyed only visually; the semantic text strips the markers and provides no indication of emphasis, so screen reader users do not receive the same emphasis information as sighted users.

violations.type: Semantic content mismatch with visual truncation
violations.explanation: When maxLines/clip truncate the visible text, the semantics still expose the full text, and clipped text without ellipsis gives sighted users no indication that content is hidden, which can disadvantage low-vision users using text scaling.
